summary: The iOS app no longer stays 'reconnecting' until it is killed: a collections socket that never opens counts as a failed try after 15 s, and a fabric route that failed is dialed again by itself after 30 s, 1 min, 2 min, then every 5 min while it is wanted (the app had fallen back to a saved route it could not reach and never tried fabric again until the next foreground); the app also sends its local hourly measurements (ios-recover, ios-connect, ios-message-ack and the others) to the member, which it had recorded but never reported

replay.detail: No replay, backfill, stored data or transcript change.

schema.detail: No schema, operation or contract digest change. The app now calls the existing observations.report with flat samples as the contract defines it.

rules.detail: No claim, checkpoint, retention or authority rule change.

compatibility.detail: An older member that does not take observations.report refuses it; the app keeps the batch, bounded, and asks again at the next measurement. A carrier the member does not know (HTTPS) is left out of reports.

downtime.detail: Client-only change; a new phone build is needed to see it.

manual.detail: A new phone build must be installed.

recovery.detail: No recovery, durable payload or initialization changes.
